column_description: A BIGSERIAL PK identifying a market data snapshot (e.g., 987654).

JSONB column. Captures a full market‑microstructure snapshot—best quotes, size, depth, spreads, and derived mid/mark/index prices—inside a single JSONB column.
Fields: {"depth":{"askdepth":"A REAL summarizing deeper ask liquidity (e.g., 42.1).","askunits":"A NUMERIC(12,4) quantity at best ask (e.g., '8.0000').","biddepth":"A REAL summarizing deeper bid liquidity (e.g., 56.7).","bidunits":"A NUMERIC(12,4) quantity at best bid (e.g., '12.5000')."},"metadata":{"exchnote":"A CHAR(10) for exchange code (e.g., 'FTX').","mktcombo":"A VARCHAR(30) naming the trading pair (e.g., 'ETH/USDT').","timetrack":"A TIMESTAMP noting when data was recorded (e.g., '2025-05-10 13:45:30')."},"quotes":{"askquote":"A DECIMAL(12,3) best ask price (e.g., '27555.100').","bidquote":"A DECIMAL(12,3) best bid price (e.g., '27550.250').","indexquote":"A DECIMAL(12,3) index price if used (e.g., '27560.125').","markquote":"A DECIMAL(12,3) reference 'mark' price for derivatives (e.g., '27553.000').","midquote":"A DECIMAL(12,3) midpoint price (e.g., '27552.675')."},"spread":{"spreadband":"A DOUBLE PRECISION for raw spread (e.g., 4.850).","spreadrate":"A DECIMAL(8,4) spread as a ratio or percentage (e.g., '0.0175')."}}
